At which station do they transfer? Answer with the station name exactly as printed on the map.

Answer the question using the image. Think it through, then give the answer exactly as written on the map (just the name, nothing else).
End your reply with a final line of the form:
FINAL ANSWER: <answer>

content:

There, transfer within the station (the outlined N, Q, R, D, F markers show an in-station transfer) to an N, Q, or R train. Continue north through 42 St-Bryant Pk to Times Sq-42 St, where the trip ends.

This is one transfer and about three stops in total. I did not find a shorter one-transfer option, since the 42 St-Bryant Pk D/F and N/Q/R stops are not marked as a transfer.

34 St-Herald Sq

FINAL ANSWER: 34 St-Herald Sq
